exact.無監督：像就近、不像推開；LLE 是無監督幾何高手。: Unsupervised: similar points stay close, dissimilar ones get pushed apart; LLE is an unsupervised geometry expert.
exact.監督：推開類間（紅低藍高）收攏類內（揉成 (3,3) 與 (16,16)），分數: Supervised: push the classes apart (red low, blue high) and pull each class together (squeezed into (3,3) and (16,16)); the scores 5 vs 16 are the labels.
exact.$f_\\theta(x)=a$ 是策略：狀態挑行動；強化學習靠糖果/棍棒累積獎: $f_\theta(x)=a$ is a policy: the state picks the action; reinforcement learning relies on candy/stick to accumulate reward, with AlphaGo and the like as examples.

5d539ea37099.en: ML THEORY V · Dimensionality Reduction and Reinforcement Learning

棍棒的教養 — Dimensionality Reduction & Reinforcement Learning

The magic of squashing,
an upbringing by the rod — Dimensionality Reduction & Reinforcement Learning

2a9e4c08cdda.en: From $\mathbb{R}^{10000}$ to $\mathbb{R}^1$, and on to an agent that learns to walk through rewards and punishments

d6256f5bf688.zh:
行李裝不下，
怎麼辦？ Too much luggage — what to do? Fold wisely (DR) or learn by trial & reward (RL).
d6256f5bf688.en:
The luggage won't fit —
now what? Fold wisely (DR) or learn by trial & reward (RL).

77bb349cc835.zh: $100\times100$ 照片 = $\mathbb{R}^{10000}$，誰能畫出一萬維？只能壓扁。$\mathbb{R}^{10000}$ is unpaintable — compress.
77bb349cc835.en: A $100\times100$ photo = $\mathbb{R}^{10000}$. Who can draw ten thousand dimensions? All we can do is squash it.

cd2a33974d37.zh: 維度災難：為何要降維？Curse of Dimensionality
cd2a33974d37.en: The curse of dimensionality: why reduce dimensions?

67b25d2d2922.zh: 一張 $100\times100$ 黑白照在電腦眼裡是 $\mathbb{R}^{10000}$ 的點，太複雜、畫不出來、算不動。$\mathbb{R}^{10000}$ point — too big to plot or compute.
67b25d2d2922.en: To a computer, one $100\times100$ black-and-white photo is a point in $\mathbb{R}^{10000}$: too complex, impossible to plot, too heavy to compute.

cdf1b98ff05c.zh: 直覺 · Intuition — 行李箱比喻

18b53d2ebb2a.zh: 帶太多東西行李裝不下，怎麼辦？把衣服摺好、空氣擠掉、體積壓小但該帶的都在—— 這就是降維。Fold clothes, squeeze air — smaller but keeps essentials.
18b53d2ebb2a.en: You're bringing too much stuff and the luggage won't fit. What do you do? Fold the clothes neatly, squeeze out the air, shrink the volume, yet everything you need is still there — that is dimensionality reduction.

1601846c639e.zh: 目標：把高維點雲壓到 $\mathbb{R}^1$ 數線或 $\mathbb{R}^2$ 平面，讓人看得懂、電腦算得動。Goal: map to $\mathbb{R}^1$ line or $\mathbb{R}^2$ plane.
1601846c639e.en: Goal: squash a high-dimensional point cloud down to the $\mathbb{R}^1$ number line or the $\mathbb{R}^2$ plane, so people can understand it and computers can handle the computation.

01c71aa8534c.zh: 無監督式降維：自己找模式的幾何魔術Unsupervised DR — Find Pattern Alone
01c71aa8534c.en: Unsupervised dimensionality reduction: geometric magic that finds patterns on its own

927410d38429.zh: 夜市小白 · Night Market Novice

6b71b7885677.zh: 外國小白丟進士林夜市，只說「把很像的放一組」—— 黑黏蒸籠一堆、金黃油炸一堆，雖不知名字但結構對了。“Group by similarity” — structure without names.
6b71b7885677.en: Drop a clueless foreigner into the Shilin Night Market and just say “put the things that look alike in the same group” — the black, sticky steamer baskets go in one pile, the golden deep-fried stuff in another. They don't know the names, but the structure is right.

3ec1f3b99f07.zh: 丟 $\mathbb{R}^d$ 高維原料，映射成緊密的 $\mathbb{R}^p$ 低維果汁。High-dim in → tight low-dim out.
3ec1f3b99f07.en: Throw in high-dimensional raw ingredients in $\mathbb{R}^d$, and map them into a compact low-dimensional juice in $\mathbb{R}^p$.

d2b375a34282.zh: 原本很像的點壓後「還是很像、更擠」；原本不像的用力推開。Keep neighbors close, push strangers apart.
d2b375a34282.en: Points that were very similar to begin with are “still very similar, and even more tightly packed” after squashing; points that were dissimilar get pushed hard apart.

e4858464ddd4.zh: 早期高手：LLE（Locally Linear Embedding）靠直覺的幾何。Early master: LLE — geometric intuition.
e4858464ddd4.en: An early master: LLE (locally linear embedding), which relies on intuitive geometry.

b5c342e16158.zh: 監督式降維：色盲看懂顏色的遊戲Supervised DR — Color-blind Sees Color
b5c342e16158.en: Supervised dimensionality reduction: helping the color-blind see color

124d3a310354.zh: 電腦只懂黑白灰度，紅藍球在它眼裡全是灰點，無法說「紅放一組」。Computer sees grayscale; red & blue both gray.
124d3a310354.en: The computer only understands black, white and shades of gray: in its eyes the red and blue balls are all gray dots, so it can't say “put the reds in one group.”

f9c2b02377cd.zh: 把混一起的灰點雲拉開：紅低、藍高Pull apart.
f9c2b02377cd.en: Pull apart the mixed-up cloud of gray dots: red low, blue high

a079cc4bee8a.zh: 零散各團揉成緊密一坨：(3,3) 與 (16,16)Tighten within.
a079cc4bee8a.en: Squeeze each scattered group into one tight lump: (3,3) and (16,16)

a24e54210f0c.zh: 色盲也能分：$y=5$ 藍 vs $16$ 暖Score = label.
a24e54210f0c.en: Even the color-blind can tell them apart: $y=5$ is blue vs $16$ is warm

f9e4c1b97656.zh: 此即 FDA（Fisher Discriminant Analysis） 核心：監督資訊輔助，幾何分數代行顏色。FDA idea: supervised geometry replaces color.
f9e4c1b97656.en: This is the core of FDA (Fisher Discriminant Analysis): with the help of supervision (labels), a geometric score stands in for color.

855a5ed53e00.zh: 兩種降維對比Unsupervised vs Supervised DR
855a5ed53e00.en: Two kinds of dimensionality reduction compared

2d31d64e50ca.zh: Fig 1 · 左：無監督靠鄰居直覺；右：有監督靠標籤把類拉開收攏 (Left: LLE-like; Right: FDA-like)
2d31d64e50ca.en: Fig 1 · Left: unsupervised, relying on intuition about neighbors; right: supervised, using labels to push the classes apart and pull each class together

4441a810339d.zh: 無標籤，靠「像就近」no labels, keep neighbors
4441a810339d.en: No labels; relies on “similar means close”

beef83a35735.zh: 有標籤，推開類間收攏類內push apart + tighten
beef83a35735.en: Has labels; pushes the classes apart and pulls each class together

f62959ab70c9.zh: 幾何投影與映射：$\mathbb{R}^2\to\mathbb{R}^1$ 的魔術Geometric Projection & Mapping
f62959ab70c9.en: Geometric projection and mapping: the magic of $\mathbb{R}^2\to\mathbb{R}^1$

d663f1f5ee49.zh: Fig 2 · 左：幾何投影演示（正交路徑）；右：低維嵌入（緊密兩團） (Left: projection; Right: embedding)
d663f1f5ee49.en: Fig 2 · Left: geometric projection demo (orthogonal paths); right: low-dimensional embedding (two tight clusters)

57f64c1e0579.en: How to read the left plot

319d3eab43b5.zh: 青虛線為正交投影路徑；金線為 $\mathbf{w}$ 方向；暖/藍為遠/近。Cyan = projection; gold = $\mathbf{w}$.
319d3eab43b5.en: The cyan dashed lines are the orthogonal projection paths; the gold line is the direction of $\mathbf{w}$; warm/blue mean far/near.

e6f06eb3c47c.en: How to read the right plot

2506bbf9a4e7.zh: 同批點在 $y=x_1+x_2$ 數線上變兩緊密團，綠虛線為類間距。Same points → two tight clusters on line.
2506bbf9a4e7.en: The same points become two tight clusters on the number line $y=x_1+x_2$; the green dashed line is the between-class distance.

02e64df17195.zh: 與前兩講共享同一批 $\mathbb{R}^2$ 點，強調「方法不同、幾何目標不同」。Same points as before; different goals.
02e64df17195.en: Uses the same set of $\mathbb{R}^2$ points as the previous two lectures, to stress that “different methods, different geometric goals.”

b567036d835a.zh: 輸出空間 $\mathbb{R}^1$：緊密即是答案Output Space $\mathbb{R}^1$: Tight is Answer
b567036d835a.en: Output space $\mathbb{R}^1$: tight means you have the answer

70974e4a199f.zh: 嵌入分數分佈 · Embedding Scores — 低團 vs 高團 (tight clusters)
70974e4a199f.en: Distribution of embedding scores: low cluster vs high cluster

24a5c1f5e583.zh: 壓得越緊，越易分類、越易視覺化、越去噪。Tighter → easier to classify & visualize.
24a5c1f5e583.en: The tighter the squeeze, the easier it is to classify, the easier to visualize, and the more noise is removed.

b3fde35206d1.zh: 降維架構：高維 → 低維DR Architecture — High to Low

2f918c226da8.zh: 無監督：像就近 / 有監督：推開類間 + 收攏類內
2f918c226da8.en: Unsupervised: similar → close / Supervised: push classes apart + pull each together

c83850c52925.zh: Fig 3 · 降維流水線 (pipeline high → low)

f01482234e60.zh: 強化學習：棍棒與糖果的教育Reinforcement Learning — Stick & Candy
f01482234e60.en: Reinforcement learning: an education by stick and candy

a5e1b0248c22.zh: 小老弟收玩具 · Teaching Little Brother
a5e1b0248c22.en: Getting little brother to put his toys away

1f6092937f60.zh: 不收 → 沒糖吃（負獎勵）；碰巧放回樂高 → 給糖（正獎勵）。隨機亂動中學出心法。No tidy → no candy; tidy → candy.
1f6092937f60.en: Doesn't tidy up → no candy (negative reward); happens to put the Lego back → candy (positive reward). Out of random fumbling, he learns the knack.

29612c3a4e79.zh: 模型 $f$（代理 Agent）在任何狀態 $\mathbf{x}$ 下，從可行動集合 $A$ 挑最讚的 $a$。In state $\mathbf{x}$, pick best action $a$ from $A$.
29612c3a4e79.en: In any state $\mathbf{x}$, the model $f$ (the agent) picks the best $a$ from the set of possible actions $A$.

67ec5c5cff24.zh: 強化學習迴路：狀態 → 行動 → 獎懲 → 新狀態RL Loop — State → Action → Reward → New State
67ec5c5cff24.en: Reinforcement learning loop: state → action → reward/punishment → new state

986d7965c4ec.zh: 強化學習迴路：電腦小白的棍棒與糖果教育
986d7965c4ec.en: RL loop: stick-and-candy schooling for a computer newbie

aa307a9ff6d7.zh: Agent 依狀態選動作 → 環境回饋新狀態與獎懲 → 反覆迭代最大化累積獎勵
aa307a9ff6d7.en: Agent picks an action from the state → environment returns a new state and reward → repeat to maximize cumulative reward

b00c9d0dc55d.zh: 狀態轉換與獎懲產生器

101ed1fc2cee.zh: 獎懲  r    糖果 🍭 / 棍棒

dc276c452cc1.zh: Fig 4 · 強化學習迴路：Agent ↔ Environment（講義 SVG 原圖重繪，亮化）(agent-environment loop)
dc276c452cc1.en: Fig 4 · Reinforcement learning loop: agent ↔ environment (redrawn and brightened from the lecture notes' original SVG)

3558f95d97c6.zh: 小老弟亂動→碰巧放對→得糖→記住心法「玩具很亂時就收拾」。Agent 起初隨機，與環境反覆互動、領賞調整，最終學會最大化累積獎勵的策略。Random → lucky hit → reward → remember; repeat to maximize cumulative reward.
3558f95d97c6.en: Little brother fumbles around → happens to put something back right → gets candy → remembers the rule “when the toys are messy, tidy them up”. The agent starts out acting randomly, interacts with the environment over and over, collects rewards and adjusts, and finally learns a policy that maximizes cumulative reward.

e2017e610de4.zh: 從哪學會智慧？Where Does Intelligence Come From?

93ac20a8389c.en: Learned through education by the stick

bc1beb873617.zh: AlphaGo、自動導航，皆靠環境滾打。AlphaGo, self-driving — learned by rolling in env.
bc1beb873617.en: AlphaGo and autonomous navigation both learned by knocking about in their environment.

676bb646d5f2.zh: 監督：老師手把手；非監督：夜市找結構；強化：社會滾打。Supervised: teacher; Unsupervised: structure; RL: society.
676bb646d5f2.en: Supervised: a teacher guides you hand in hand; unsupervised: finding structure at the night market; reinforcement: knocking about in society.

db8cab670f7b.zh: 今日總結：三段變奏Summary — Three Variations

348db59eeb04.zh: $f:\mathbb{R}^d\to\mathbb{R}^p$ 無標籤，近者更近。LLENo labels, keep close.
348db59eeb04.en: $f:\mathbb{R}^d\to\mathbb{R}^p$, no labels: points that are close get even closer. LLE

d8a5958e9a05.zh: 有標籤，推開類間收攏類內。FDAPush & tighten.
d8a5958e9a05.en: With labels: push the classes apart and pull each class together. FDA

7df900fa32a5.zh: $f_\theta(x)=a\in A$ 靠獎懲學策略。Learn policy by rewards.
7df900fa32a5.en: $f_\theta(x)=a\in A$ learns a policy from rewards and punishments.

fb209354eb8f.zh: Q1. 無監督降維的目標是？LLE 屬於哪派？Unsupervised DR goal?
fb209354eb8f.en: Q1. What is the goal of unsupervised dimensionality reduction? Which camp does LLE belong to?

d64f20607baa.zh: B. 原本很像的壓後更像、不像的推開；LLE 屬無監督 (keep close, push apart; LLE unsupervised)
d64f20607baa.en: B. Points that were alike become even more alike after compression, and unlike ones are pushed apart; LLE is unsupervised

463d759ffbcd.zh: Q2. 監督式降維（FDA 思想）如何讓色盲分顏色？Supervised DR trick?
463d759ffbcd.en: Q2. How does supervised dimensionality reduction (the FDA idea) let a color-blind person tell colors apart?

50c75f1a545b.zh: A. 告訴它「這是紅色」 (tell color)

9838d1140ed5.zh: B. 放大灰度 (amplify gray)

33495dd56f6c.zh: C. 推開類間、收攏類內 → $y=5$ vs $16$ 兩緊密團 (push + tighten → 5 vs 16)
33495dd56f6c.en: C. Push the classes apart and pull each class together → two tight clusters, $y=5$ vs $16$

183e61d8667e.zh: D. 把維度變大 (increase dim)

fd1e1109a2c8.zh: Q3. $f_\theta(x)=a\in A$ 在說什麼？強化學習像什麼？Eq.8 meaning?
fd1e1109a2c8.en: Q3. What is $f_\theta(x)=a\in A$ saying? What is reinforcement learning like?

b39052514536.zh: A. 在狀態 $x$ 挑行動 $a$；像棍棒與糖果的社會滾打 (pick action; stick & candy)
b39052514536.en: A. In state $x$, pick action $a$; it's like knocking about in society, with stick and candy

d982a3c1f122.zh:
壓扁是為了看清，
滾打是為了學會。 Compress to see; roll to learn. $p<d$ for insight, $r$ for policy.
d982a3c1f122.en:
We compress things to see them clearly;
we take our knocks to learn. $p<d$ for insight, $r$ for policy.
